goal: Lock Vol 3 SDX defeat of X2
body: AUTHORIAL CANON DECISION: Vol 3 must include SDX defeating X2 fairly and decisively. SDX is Route 2 Xoah, Akuma-tier Level 9. X2 is still below her. The loss cannot be excused by ambush, exhaustion, or technicality. X2 should know SDX could have killed her and chose not to, preserving SDX as hunter and causal forge. This power proof is necessary so the 1000+ anime centered on SDX feels earned and so Vol 4 hurts when the Shadow King mortally maims SDX and she chooses convergence into X2 as salvation. Shards capture endpoint returned 502 twice, so persist this via relay and capture when shard write is restored.
